items.title: The Gate in the Sea
items.task: Why is the torii in the water?
items.reveal: The shrine treats the island as holy. The gate stands in the tidal approach.
items.notes: Confirm sacred-island / tide / torii placement wording before live.

items.title: Where Did the Water Go?
items.task: If the tide is out, walk the sand. If it is in, watch the gate stand in the sea. Is the sea part of the architecture?
items.reveal: No right answer. The building is designed with the tide.

items.title: Deer Again?
items.task: You met deer in Nara. These deer are not the same story. Do not feed them human snacks.
items.notes: Callback only. Do not copy Kasuga symbolism here.
